data.title: Rejection of forest road driving permit
data.summary: The district office (Landratsamt Beispielkreis) rejected your application of 14 October 2025 for an exemption permit to drive on the forest road "Am Hochries". The letter is dated 2 December 2025 and no costs are charged.
data.explanation: Your application was rejected because the road is closed to general motor traffic and you did not show a special need. The authority says your property can be reached via the municipal road. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the office (zur Niederschrift); the app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You may seek professional advice if the access matters to you.
